source.license: CC BY 4.0 (source audit declaration; verify before redistribution)
source.licenseDeclaredInLocalSourceAudit: license and citation recorded in existing Perea source audit; this report does not independently re-check current upstream terms

preprocessing.duplicatePolicy: Same-label rows for an animal-minute collapse to one row with mean motion index; all rows for conflicting-label minutes are excluded.

coverage.timeZone: Source describes Mountain Time, but rows contain no UTC offset or DST fold; timestamps are preserved as naive local wall-clock values and are not converted to UTC.
coverage.sessionDefinition: A contiguous window requires exactly one minute between eligible adjacent animal observations; any gap or conflicting-label minute breaks the window. This is an operational coverage window, not a source-declared video session.

annotationLimitations.carryForward: README reports that labels for events shorter than 30 seconds may carry forward a previous annotation. Original sub-minute event timing is unavailable; observed run lengths are not unbiased biological bout durations.
annotationLimitations.durationInterpretation: Run lengths count eligible annotated minute samples. Runs touching a contiguous-window boundary are censored; these are descriptive annotation runs, not full behavior duration estimates.
annotationLimitations.temporalSupport: Sampled video windows only; no complete 24-hour window supports daily activity budgets or circadian claims.

compatibility.rowOrderAndDuplicatePolicy: Same animal-minute grouping; conflicting label keys excluded; same-label keys collapsed with mean MI; sorted by animal, timestamp, source line.
